info.title: sdcm
info.description: Command-line tool to automate Microsoft Hardware Dev Center (Partner Center) driver and firmware submissions. A modernized fork of microsoft/SDCM.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: sdcm - automate Microsoft Hardware Dev Center driver and firmware submissions

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --profile
options.description: Named credential profile from authconfig.json to use [default: default]

options.name: --auth
options.description: Credential type: auto (default), managed-identity, client-secret, interactive [default: auto]

options.name: --aad
options.description: Interactive sign-in behavior: never (default), prompt, always, refresh-session, select-account [default: never]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to authconfig.json (overrides the usual discovery order)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: HTTP request timeout, in seconds [default: 300]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: text (default) or json [default: text]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose diagnostic logging on stderr [default: False]

options.name: --replay
options.description: Offline fixture file (also SDCM_REPLAY). Skips credentials and talks to a fake backend.

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Commit a submission, finalizing its package set. Already-committed submissions are a no-op.

options.description: Product id the submission belongs to

options.name: --submission-id
options.description: Submission id to commit

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload a submission's package (refused unless commitStatus is commitPending)

options.name: --product-id
options.description: Product id the submission belongs to

options.name: --submission-id
options.description: Submission id to upload the package to

options.name: --package
options.description: Path to the package file to upload

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download a submission's signed package

options.name: --product-id
options.description: Product id the submission belongs to

options.name: --submission-id
options.description: Submission id to download the signed package from

options.name: --output-file
options.description: Destination file path for the downloaded package

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the destination file if it already exists [default: False]

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Wait until a signedPackage is available (or finalizeIngestion completed). Failure is terminal at any step.

options.name: --product-id
options.description: Product id the submission belongs to

options.name: --submission-id
options.description: Submission id to wait on

options.name: --wait-metadata
options.description: Also wait until publisher metadata is available for download [default: False]

options.name: --poll-interval
options.description: Seconds between status checks [default: 5]

options.name: --wait-timeout
options.description: Give up after this many seconds (default: wait indefinitely)
